explanation: The intended subtraction is 7 − 4 = 3 (option e), but the premises are impossible. For N = A + I, successive nullity increments are nonincreasing. A fifth increment of 3 would require each of the first four increments to be at least 3, forcing nullity(N⁴) ≥ 12, contradicting the stated value 4. No such matrix exists.
